# T05 synthetic citation cases

All cases are authored synthetic German text, not saved provider/model output or
medical guidance. `{cite}` expands to a numbered marker for a synthetic diabinfo
URL. Metadata in the test builder has T01's saved Markdown/reference-pointer shape;
it does not claim a real capture. `available` coverage is explicitly fixture-only
when citations are present: current T01 normalization keeps those captures incomplete.
Claims are synthetic shared Claim records. They never satisfy genuine T04 integration.

Existing T00 fixtures remain contract examples, not semantic citation ground truth.
